jobs.occupation: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Documented education as engineer or technician

• 
Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

• 
Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

• 
Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

• 
Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Your experience

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. Responsibilities

Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. **Svitzer is a leading global towage operator with 4,500 colleagues and a fleet of 510 vessels operating across more than 35 countries. Every day, we help keep ports open, terminals operating and global trade moving through safe, reliable and increasingly sustainable marine services. If you would like to see our tugboats in action and learn more, visit our website and watch this short video: Svitzer Introduces TRAnsverse Tug.

**What We Offer

**At Svitzer, we are a truly people-centric company with safety at our core, driven to innovate and succeed together, with our customers’ interests in focus.

You will become part of an ambitious global organisation where commercial drive and accountability go hand in hand with collaboration across cultures. You will be encouraged to take ownership and have the opportunity to help shape the role in our fairly new team. We offer flexible ways of working and room to develop.

**Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Drive the implementation of Svitzer’s Commercial Excellence agenda, helping translate commercial priorities into practical frameworks, tools and ways of working.

• Support the development and continuous improvement of commercial processes, tools and methodologies that enable consistent and effective commercial execution.

• Run Svitzer’s annual NPS process, including gathering and analysing input and helping translate customer feedback into relevant actions.

• Drive the Key Customer Programme for Svitzer, which entails establishing best practices for our main key accounts.

• Support commercial planning, customer segmentation and performance management across regions.

• Help strengthen commercial capabilities through training, knowledge-sharing and practical support to regional and local commercial teams.

• Analyse commercial data, insights and performance measures and use these to support commercial decision-making.

• Contribute to the development of customer value propositions and commercial approaches that reflect customer needs and Svitzer’s strategic priorities.

• Work with regional and local commercial teams to support the adoption of common tools and processes, while recognising different market needs.

• Facilitate knowledge-sharing and exchange of commercial best practices across regions.

• Identify and suggest improvements to how we collaborate with a focus on simplicity, customer value and effective execution.

**Who We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded professional with strong analytical skills and an interest in developing how commercial teams work and perform. You probably have 5–7 years of experience in a commercial role.

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across functions, regions and cultures and are comfortable working on several initiatives and stakeholder relationships at the same time. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy turning ideas and insights into solutions that can be used in the business.

**In Particular, We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• A valid work and residence permit for Denmark (this is a must).

• Good business and commercial understanding, including an understanding of how customer needs can turn into commercial outcomes.

• Relevant experience from Commercial Excellence, business development, commercial operations, pricing, sales effectiveness or a related area.

• Experience working with or improving commercial processes, tools and frameworks.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data and insights into clear conclusions and recommendations.

• Good project-management and coordination skills.

• The ability to build effective working relationships with diverse stakeholders.

• A pragmatic and collaborative approach and an ability to make complex topics practical and understandable.

• Good communication and presentation skills.

• Experience from an international organisation is an advantage.

• Fluency in English.

You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. We value diverse experiences and are interested in your motivation, potential and ability to grow in the role.

**How To Apply

**To ensure a consistent and fair recruitment process, please submit your CV and a motivational letter via the “Apply” button on our Svitzer Careers page. Applications submitted outside the system cannot be considered. Please leave out information about age, gender, religion or other factors not related to the role. A photo is not required.

**Deadline

**The deadline for your application is 30 November 2026. However, we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the job advertisement earlier if we receive a strong field of qualified candidates.

**Questions

**To ensure a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we will not respond to questions in advance of interviews. Relevant questions can be addressed during the interview process.

**Building a Diverse Workplace

**In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

**How To Apply

**To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

**We’re Looking For Two Student Workers To Join Our Engineering & RD&E Excellence Team. Our Job Is To Make Work Simpler, More Consistent And More Effective For Danfoss’ Global Engineering Organization.There Are Two Positions With Different Focus Areas

Process & Governance Support: for you who likes structure, clear documentation and working with people across the organization.

Both positions are on the same curious, open team. Your ideas are welcome here, and your work will be used by colleagues around the world.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work with colleagues across our global RD&E organization. In both positions, success means delivering practical work that colleagues can use, building good relationships across countries, and turning feedback into real improvements. In the PDM Digital & AI position, it also means building reliable, well-documented solutions for the global PDM team.

Process & Governance Support

• Review and update process descriptions, documentation, meeting templates and working standards

• Coordinate feedback and reach out to stakeholders across functions and locations

• Explore how AI can make our ways of working simpler and more efficient

• Work closely with process owners, meeting owners, specialists and senior stakeholders

PDM Digital & AI Suppor

• Write code and build small digital tools, automations and AI-based solutions

• Work with users in the global PDM team to understand their challenges and make sure your solutions meet real needs

• Test, improve and document the solutions you build

**What We're Looking For

**

• You’re enrolled in a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s program and can work as a student worker in Denmark

• You speak and write English fluently, and you work independently and take ownership of your tasks

• You enjoy working with international colleagues and reaching out to stakeholders at all levels

• For Process & Governance: structured, comfortable with documentation, and confident reaching out to stakeholders at different seniority levels.

• For PDM Digital & AI: interest in programming, automation, and AI, ideally through studies in software engineering, computer science, data science, engineering, digitalization, or a related field.

**

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

_Apply AI to healthcare challenges that matter. Join our Innovation team in Aarhus for a hands-on internship where you'll develop AI solutions that support clinical decision-making for healthcare professionals worldwide.

_**Expected start:

February 2027

**The internship You'll work on real AI challenges in healthcare, contributing to developing features that help clinicians make better decisions. From data exploration to model analysis, you'll experience the full data science workflow and see your work integrated into products that improve patient care across hospitals and communities.

Your key responsibilities include:

• developing and experimenting with ML/AI models for healthcare products, working with areas such as natural language processing, speech recognition, or translation.

• assisting in prompt engineering and working with large language models (LLMs)

• processing, analysing, and visualising data of different shapes and sizes

• contributing to model evaluation, documentation, and testing

• collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, architects, product managers, and domain experts

• participating in technical sparring sessions and code reviews

• bringing fresh ideas and perspectives to the team's innovation efforts

**Join our Innovation team in Healthcare

**Our Healthcare Innovation team sits at the heart of Systematics' mission to support healthcare professionals in critical environments. We develop AI solutions that simplify decision-making for users of our Columna platform worldwide. You'll join six colleagues - data scientists, architects and developers - who are eager to share their knowledge and explore what AI can achieve in healthcare. The team thrives on informal communication, mutual trust and genuine curiosity. We also enjoy coffee breaks, plenty of cake and laughs, and occasional matches on our padel court.

**Your Qualifications

**You are pursuing a MSc in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Cognitive Science, Statistics, or similar, and you have:

• practical experience with Python, working with data analysis and statistical/ML modelling using e.g. Tensorflow/Transformers

• understanding of LLMs and prompt engineering – you have experimented with large language models and understand their potential applications

• experience developing or implementing machine learning models – you have built models from data preprocessing through to evaluation

• you understand data handling, model evaluation, the visualisation of data-driven solutions and the development of best practices.

• appreciate teamwork and has good communication skills

• you speak and write English fluently as it is our corporate language. It is also an advantage if you can speak Danish, but this is not a requirement.

• knowledge of Docker and FastAPI is not required, but is an advantage

The internship is a full-time position lasting five months, commencing on 1 February 2027. The position is unpaid; however, if permitted by your academic programme, you will receive a monthly token of appreciation during your internship.

To be eligible, you must be enrolled in a Danish study program and be based in Denmark during the internship period.

**Life as an Intern

**Interns are valued members of our teams. From day one, you will be assigned a dedicated tutor or mentor who will guide your development and provide ongoing support. You will work alongside experienced colleagues eager to share their knowledge, while being entrusted with real responsibility early in your journey.

We believe in delivering high-quality solutions while maintaining a positive work environment – whether through shared laughter over coffee, engaging discussions, or meaningful connections with colleagues. Beyond your immediate team, you will join our intern network, where you can build relationships and participate in social events with other interns across the organization.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have resided in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events annually of both social and professional nature. You will also benefit from a range of on-site amenities, including physiotherapist-led massages, an in-house hairdresser, sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a highlight, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will enjoy benefits such as free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Start your development here We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to find our new intern as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV, Cover Letter and exam certificates. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Peter Dahl, Senior Data Scientist.

Are you motivated by ensuring smooth execution while leading a dedicated team and collaborating with customers, production sites, warehouse partners, and transport providers?

“We are looking for a Logistics Operations Manager to lead and develop the Danish 3PL warehouse and transport setup. The role focuses on operational performance management with a future potential for strategic and tactical network warehouse design,” says Janni Jepsen, Director for Warehouse & Outbound Logistics.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**As Logistics Operations Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing logistics operations and leading a small team in a complex environment where customer requirements, warehouse execution, transportation, and production planning must come together seamlessly. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing a small operational team

• Owning and developing performance across both 3PL warehousing and 3PL transportation

• Developing robust decision material and recommendations for 3PL partner decisions

• Ensuring high customer service levels and operational reliability

• Coordinating activities across production sites, logistics providers, customers, and commercial teams

• Monitoring and improving key performance indicators such as service level, completion rate, inventory accuracy, productivity, and cost

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives across processes and systems

• Managing operational escalations and resolving supply chain challenges proactively

• Ensuring compliance with quality, food safety, and safety standards

**What Will Make You Successful

**We are looking for a candidate who combines strong operational understanding with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries. You bring a strategic and analytical mindset and can turn network insights into practical changes and measurable business improvements. You likely have:

• Experience from logistics, supply chain, warehousing, transportation, or operations management

• Experience with 3PL management across both warehousing and transportation

• Experience with strategic or tactical logistics network design, capacity planning, and implementation of network changes

• A strong understanding of the end-to-end value chain from production to customer delivery

• Experience leading teams directly or through external partners

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across functions

• A structured and data-driven approach to performance management

• Experience with operational KPIs and continuous improvement methodologies

• The ability to prioritize and make decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication skills in English; Danish is an advantage

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to influence the performance of a critical logistics operation and work closely with stakeholders across the entire supply chain.

You will join a collaborative and ambitious environment where development, ownership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success. The role offers significant exposure across operations, logistics, production, and customer-facing functions, making it an excellent opportunity for further career growth within supply chain and operations leadership.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you are motivated by leading people, driving operational performance, and creating value across the supply chain, we would love to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified. If you have any questions contact Janni Jepsen, Director for Warehouse & Outbound Logistics, on JANNI.JEPSEN@ARLAFOODS.COM.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re hiring a Product Owner to build products that compliance teams at banks and payment companies rely on every day, in more than 15 countries. You’ll work across the core of the spektr platform, from onboarding and monitoring to investigations, where our AI agents are taking on work that used to take analysts hours.

You will shape what compliance looks like when AI agents do most of the work. You’ll prototype, put ideas in front of compliance teams early, and work with engineering and design to ship what holds up in a regulated environment. You’ll do it at a Series A startup that moves fast, with the autonomy to take an idea from a blank page to a product running at banks and payment companies.

This is a chance to help define how compliance gets done, not to digitise the way it’s always been done.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Prototype fast and test with real users. Build working prototypes, often with AI tools, and put them in front of compliance and operations teams at banks and payment companies in days rather than months. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t.

• Explore several ways to solve a problem before committing to one, and come back with a clear view on which gives users the best experience, and why.

• Shape the product experience with our designers. Make complex compliance workflows simple to use, so analysts spend their time on decisions, not on the tool.

• Push how far AI can go in compliance. Our customers are regulated institutions, so every automated decision has to be explainable and defensible. You’ll work out what our AI agents can take on, what a human still needs to review, and what it takes for a compliance team to trust the result, then move that line further with each release.

• Turn customer requests into platform capabilities. When a customer asks for something specific, find the version that solves their problem and fits into the existing platform, so it stays configurable and works for the next customer too.

• Work hand in hand with engineering in Copenhagen and Iași. Align on what we’re building and why, agree how it fits the platform’s direction, and make the calls that keep work moving.

• Learn from the field. Work with our implementation team, who sit on site with customers and see every rough edge first, and use what they and our production data show you to decide what to improve.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• You’ve owned product on a B2B platform and can show us what you built, how you tested it with users and what changed as a result. Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry is a plus.

• You build with AI. AI tools are part of how you prototype, research and explore ideas every day, and you have a view on how AI is changing the way products get made.

• Hands-on and fast. You’d rather show a working prototype than describe one, and you’re comfortable putting early work in front of users to learn quickly.

• Strong product and UX instincts. You can take a complex workflow and make it feel simple, and explain why one design works better than another.

• A platform thinker. When a customer asks for something, you look for the solution that fits the existing platform and scales beyond that one customer.

• Technical enough to go deep with engineers. You understand how systems, data and APIs fit together, and engineers want you in the room when decisions get made.

• Opinionated and open. You have a clear view on how things should work, argue for it, and change your mind when users or evidence show you otherwise.

• Close to customers by instinct. You’d rather sit in on a call with a bank’s onboarding team than read a summary of it.

Your route into product might have been through engineering, design, data, solutions architecture or operations. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience is a plus but isn’t a requirement.

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.
